notes: 8 configurations from 4 manufacturers: Isotech (Model 459 LN2 comparison cryostat, Model 471 argon triple-point apparatus, Model 461 LN2 boiling-point apparatus); Fluke Calibration/Hart Scientific (7380 -80 C metrology bath); Measurements International (6800C cryogen-free QHR standard CFMS-9T-30-H3, 6820T tabletop dry QHR); Cryogenic Ltd (re-condensing LHe cryostat for CCC/Josephson inserts, m-CFMS mini cryogen-free QHR magnet system). None duplicates data/cryostats (existing metrology entries are INRIM PJVS, LNE AGT, NIST LOCR, NPL mechanical); the materials agent's Cryogenic CFMS 9T is the full-size CFMS, not the m-CFMS. All values are manufacturer specifications read verbatim from manufacturer PDFs/pages (accessed 2026-11-01); temperatures converted exactly (T[mK]=(C+273.15)x1000). Research limits: the shared WebSearch budget was exhausted and Tavily returned a plan-limit error, so sources were reached by navigating manufacturer sites directly. Supracon PJVS/JAWS pages lacked cryogenic specifications (no temperature or sample space) and the MI 6200A CCC data sheet gives no operating temperature, so they were not used; cryogenic electrical-substitution radiometers, He-3 melting-curve thermometers and microthermometry calibration stages could not be sourced. Judgement calls: MI 6820T temperature.range lo=3.6 K (base) hi=4 K (operational <4 K); MI 6800C sample.height.max = the >=5 cm isothermal sample zone; 6800C/m-CFMS cryogen.type=[] (closed-loop VTI generates only internal liquid 4He), whereas the Cryogenic CCC cryostat lists liquid_helium because inserts sit in its LHe bath; Fluke 7380 conservative stability 10 mK and uniformity 12 mK (worst of the stated points); Isotech 459 vacuum pump treated as an option not fitted.
